title: pointset to octree image filter
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkPointSetToOctreeImageFilter generating an octree image from a sphere point set, rendered with GPU volume ray casting using maximum intensity projection.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkArrayCalculator](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkArrayCalculator.html) — computes derived arrays from existing data using expressions.
- [vtkColorTransferFunction](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkColorTransferFunction.html) — maps scalar values to RGB colors for volume rendering.
- [vtkDataObject](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkDataObject.html) — provides field association constants for array processing.
- [vtkGPUVolumeRayCastMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGPUVolumeRayCastMapper.html) — gpu volume ray cast mapper.
- [vtkPartitionedDataSet](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPartitionedDataSet.html) — partitioned data set.
- [vtkPiecewiseFunction](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPiecewiseFunction.html) — defines a piecewise linear scalar-to-opacity mapping.
- [vtkPointSetToOctreeImageFilter](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPointSetToOctreeImageFilter.html) — point set to octree image filter.
- [vtkSphereSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSphereSource.html) — generates a tessellated sphere.
- [vtkVolume](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkVolume.html) — represents a volume in the scene.
- [vtkVolumeProperty](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkVolumeProperty.html) — controls volume rendering appearance (color, opacity, shading).
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
